name: Handwriting Reveal
author: nodemode
description: Writes a text layer on by hand: traces the centre line of every letter in its own font, orders the strokes the way a pen draws them, previews the writing, and adds animated strokes that reveal the real text through a track matte or draw it as ink. One undo step; change the duration, pen lifts and easing and write it again.

commands.title: Write On the Selected Text Layer
